title: NASA Earth at Night / Black Marble, 2012 grayscale

derivative.method: Exact 2x2 encoded grayscale block mean, integer round half up, no crop. PNG RGB8 via Windows GDI+; all three channels identical.

credit: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Roman, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center.
limitations: Display brightness, not calibrated radiance or a census of cities.
Composite observed in 2012, reprocessed for the 2017 Earth at Night release; independent of the 2012/2023 audio frames.
Black pixels do not establish measured zero or scientific absence.
Downsampling, interpolation and amber color presentation reduce spatial detail; no artificial points are inserted.
A static all-night composite, not live illumination or an astronomical day/night terminator.
